name: input-router
description: Big MCP connector results and long PDFs are read by Haiku first; Claude gets short notes and the path of the full text. Plain Read and Bash are left alone (context-mode owns those). /input-router [on|off|status].

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Route big MCP results and long PDFs through Haiku. /input-router off turns it off for good until /input-router on.

mcpThresholdChars.title: MCP result limit (characters)
mcpThresholdChars.description: An MCP result at or over this size is trimmed, then read by Haiku. Smaller results pass through untouched.

pdfPages.title: PDF page limit
pdfPages.description: A Read of a PDF with more pages than this (and no pages argument) is read by Haiku.

maxChunks.title: Most Haiku chunks
maxChunks.description: Each chunk is about 100,000 characters read in parallel. Text past the last chunk is not read, and the notes say how much.
